name: Perfumare
source:
A dark fantasy visual novel with elements of mystery and romance set in a fictional world not so different from ours, where some people are born with a strange affliction called 'the gift'.

[From [url=https://pdrr.itch.io/perfumare]itch.io[/url]]

The developer retooled this game into the non-VN interactive fiction [url=https://pdrr.itch.io/perfumare-avulsion]Perfumare: Avulsion[/url].
translation:
一部融合悬疑与爱情元素的黑暗奇幻视觉小说。故事设定在一个与现实相差无几的虚构世界，那里有些人生来就患有一种名为“天赋”的奇异症状。

[摘自[url=https://pdrr.itch.io/perfumare]itch.io[/url]]

开发者将本作重新设计为一部互动小说[url=https://pdrr.itch.io/perfumare-avulsion]《Perfumare: Avulsion》[/url]，已采用视觉小说以外的形式。
